```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Test - Fleet Custom Integration Upload

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number to test against'
        required: true
        type: number
      branch:
        description: 'Branch to checkout (defaults to PR head)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  trigger-flaky-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.branch || format('refs/pull/{0}/head', github.event.inputs.pr_number) }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          yarn kbn bootstrap --quiet || true
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run specific unit tests for Fleet Custom Integration Upload
        run: |
          # Run the specific test file related to the CreateIntegrationUpload component
          # This targets the fix for the "Add to Elastic" button loading state
          yarn test:jest --testPathPattern="create_integration_upload" --testNamePattern="loading state|isNextLoading|button disabled" --verbose
        env:
          CI: true
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jest-results-${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          path: |
            coverage/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 5
```
